name: 01-Datum-Measurement-Catalog
title: DATUM
headline: Product information, made easier to compare.
summary: A technical catalog study organising measuring instruments around task, range and specification.
brief: Keep selection guidance and product data consistent across a twelve-page document. Readers need to compare instruments without confusing range, resolution and accuracy.
details: Editable comparison tables and product records
A stable typographic hierarchy for technical information
Credited instrument photography with clear context

name: 02-Material-Culture-Magazine
title: MATERIAL
headline: A magazine about objects, processes and places.
summary: An editorial publication exploring clay, printing and shared reading spaces.
brief: Move between full-page photography and sustained reading while keeping the publication coherent. The sixteen-page issue uses changes in scale and pace to separate its features.
details: Threaded editorial text and distinct feature openers
Serif reading text, pull quotes and supporting captions
Full-image pages balanced with quieter reading spreads

name: 03-Civic-Energy-Report
title: CIVIC
headline: Figures with context, structure and a clear sequence.
summary: A business-report study with illustrative energy and financial data.
brief: Turn a sample operating scenario into a navigable report. Tables, charts and explanations need consistent definitions and figures that reconcile.
details: Native editable tables and chart artwork
Executive overview, programme plan and risk register
Sample totals reconciled across the report

name: 04-Fieldnote
title: Fieldnote
headline: An outdoor itinerary in six folded panels.
summary: A roll-fold travel brochure study balancing scenic imagery with practical copy.
brief: Arrange the outer sheet in tuck, back and front order, then create a readable three-panel itinerary on the inside.
details: Separate outer and inner sheet arrangements
Non-printing fold guides in the source document
Panel-based copy and proportionate image crops

name: 05-Courtyard
title: Courtyard
headline: A compact property brochure with room to breathe.
summary: A square-format study combining interior photography and planning information.
brief: Use a restrained four-page sequence: cover, introduction, reference information and closing page.
details: Square format and circular detail crop

name: 06-Thread
title: Thread
headline: Archive, street and material in one visual sequence.
summary: A clothing and textile lookbook study with tall crops and offset compositions.
brief: Move between a contemporary street photograph, archive displays and material detail without presenting the images as a retail collection.
details: Tall portrait format and asymmetrical image placement
Serif headlines and large editorial numerals

name: 07-Daily-Form
title: Daily Form
headline: A botanical catalog with a clear product hierarchy.
summary: A beauty catalog study pairing floral photography with flat packaging illustrations.
brief: Give each sample product a clear role and a consistent information order. The pack artwork is visibly illustrated, rather than presented as product photography.
details: Product names, sample sizes and prices in a stable hierarchy
A collection index and botanical detail crops

name: 08-Table
title: Table
headline: A tall menu with calm, readable price alignment.
summary: A four-page seasonal menu study with serif headings and credited food imagery.
brief: Keep item names, supporting descriptions and prices easy to scan in a narrow page format.
details: Tall format with restrained image use

name: 09-Neighbour
title: Neighbour
headline: A small journal with a newspaper rhythm.
summary: A community newsletter study covering shared spaces, repair and reading.
brief: Use a masthead, compact columns and feature photography to give four pages a clear editorial sequence.
details: A clear newsletter masthead and issue hierarchy

name: 10-Harbor
title: Harbor
headline: A company profile organised around a concrete offer.

name: 11-Clearwater
